steps.body: When the minute hand points straight down to 6, it's **half past** the hour — the hour hand sits between two numbers. Read the SMALLER number and add ":30".

widget.successFeedback: 7:30. The long hand has gone half way round to the 6 — and notice the short hand has drifted HALF WAY between the 7 and the 8. It moves too, slowly, all the time.

widget.minuteFeedback: The hour is right but the long hand is wrong: half past means half way round, pointing at the 6.

concept.body: Minute hand at 6 means half past the hour. The hour hand sits between two numbers — use the smaller (already-passed) one. Between 3 and 4, minute hand at 6, is 3:30.

explanationVariants: Use the smaller number, 3, for half past.
